loss: trace CE + .5 counterfactual CE; nonbaseline adds image-route CE; selector arms add .5 soft-target cross entropy with relative error temperature .2
slow: after first task branch/head LR .0001; selector stays .0005
selection: validation averaged across six runs, then test only selected arm/mode and baseline
limits: No replay/prototypes/pretraining or task IDs at inference; known boundaries in training; selector has no explicit protection from forgetting; slow arm is a shared-weight slowdown, not importance-based protection
